content.text: {"core": "Steward of Resonance senses the emotional weather in a room and tends it, keeping what stirs from spilling. In Abstraction, it works on the idea pulled loose from the felt thing — the pattern lifted out to be handled cleanly. Held in proportion, the feeling rides along with the pattern: what is thought about stays warm, and the clean idea keeps the pulse it came from.", "sheetLine": "The idea stays warm; the feeling it came from rides along intact."}
